title: 0240 - THE MOD-LADDER: the JOINT missing-note pattern p mod 2310 is the dominant next-gap instrument - holdout gain +0.5555 nats/step vs +0.2043 for the FULL spf(p+2) (in-sample +0.5945/+0.2088, nulls z = +8410 / null-consistent). The 0236-0238 story is corrected: spf(p+2) is a lossy single-value summary of the joint support row; sieves 13,17,19,23 add nothing (M30030 step -0.215, null-adjusted negative). Q1'''(a) DONE: LoomWheel.lean now green with prime_hq_not_dvd_q + loom_supp_mod_q (general q) + loom_t1_spf3 + loom_t3_parity theorems (3006 jobs, 0 sorry). No RH claim
body: LOOM20 (scripts/sq/loom20_modladder.py, tmp/loom/loom20_out.txt) measured, at X = 1e8, the 0237 exact-value target (17 buckets) with the joint sieve labels p mod N, N = 3, 15, 105, 2310, 30030 (0237 protocol: cells < 30 fall back to the PAIR row). Ladder (in-sample): PAIR 2.48811; PAIR+S 2.27933 (gain +0.20877, the 0237 anchor reproduced exactly); PAIR+M3 2.32143 (+0.16667 = the 0238 one-bit anchor reproduced exactly); PAIR+M15 2.12073 (+0.36737); PAIR+M105 1.97112 (+0.51698); PAIR+M2310 1.89358 (+0.59452); PAIR+M30030 2.10877 (+0.37933, step -0.21519). Nulls (200 within-L-stratum label shuffles, 0237 protocol): M15 null +0.00014 +/-> z(M15) = +76627; M2310 null +0.00754 +/-> z = +8410; M30030 null +0.01358 +/-> z = +3245 (the M30030 level still beats its own protocol floor, but its MARGINAL beyond M2310 is (0.3793-0.0136) - (0.5945-0.0075) = -0.221: sieves 13/17/19/23 carry no measurable information). HOLDOUT (LOOM20B, scripts/sq/loom20b_holdout.py, tmp/loom/loom20b_out.txt: fit tables on odd rows, score even rows): PAIR 2.48804; PAIR+S +0.20434 (in-sample +0.20877); PAIR+M15 +0.36711 (in-sample +0.36737: survives almost exactly); PAIR+M2310 +0.55551 (in-sample +0.59452: survives at -6.6%). CONCLUSION (corrects 0236-0238): the dominant next-gap instrument is the JOINT missing-note pattern - which of the sieves 3,5,7,11 do NOT hit p+2, p+4, ... - parameterized exactly by p mod 2310; the single value s = spf(p+2) keeps only the FIRST note struck and is a lossy 2.7x-coarser summary. Mechanism: the row-wise support game of 0238/0239 (theorem side, now generalized and in-tree): each sieve q forbids one residue class of L_next mod q row-by-row (the class making p'' = p + L + L_next + 2 = 0 mod q), and the joint support carves the distribution. IN-TREE (this turn): formal/RhAttack/LoomWheel.lean BUILT GREEN (lake build RhAttack.LoomWheel, 3006 jobs, 0 errors, 0 sorry) with the new theorems: prime_hq_not_dvd_q (q-general of the non-divisibility), loom_supp_mod_q (the GENERAL support theorem: p'' = p + L + L_next + 2 prime above q => (L_next + (p + L + 2)) % q != 0), loom_t1_spf3 (T1 backbone as theorem: for odd prime p > 2, minFac (p + 2) = 3 <-> p % 3 = 1), loom_t3_parity (T3 as theorem, strongest uniform form: odd c >= 3 => minFac c != minFac (c + 2): a common spf would divide 2). Data-side probe (lake env lean): minFac 9 = 3, minFac 7 = 7, minFac 15 = 3 (T1 rows); supp row (2 + (7 + 2 + 2)) % 5 = 3 != 0 (q = 5); gap row (loomL 7 11 + loomLn 11 13) % 3 = 1 != 0 (OT 7 < 11 < 13); T3 pairs (15,19), (25,27), (33,35), (35,37), (49,51) all share-no-spf. Q1'''(a) of the autopilot plan: DONE. Next in-tree candidate (queued): the frozen p mod 2310 support-row table as a WheelTile-pattern anchor (T6+), pending the 1e8 table freeze. All off-board, no RH claim (the theorems are elementary modular arithmetic, stated as such).
